scope: deterministic Boolean AND/OR targets and a declared one-port identity/negation mode family at one fixed consumer boundary

drop_challenge_blindness.construction: commit a challenge-indexed dispatch table before the draw, then reveal the challenge label to the dispatcher

drop_temporal_precedence.construction: select the bound port/polarity mode after the challenge is known

drop_consumer_binding.construction: record an isolated sidecar state before the draw while the actual consumer dispatcher remains challenge-indexed

not_tested: physical witness independence or tamper resistance
actual port lineage/read or complete UCT organization
B_pc^family, H_cf, report reliability or subject count
arbitrary hidden-controller classes outside the declared one-port mode family
bounded_result: A public finite challenge suite is exactly mimicked by 16 challenge-indexed one-port policies for each target. Within the declared family, a consumer-bound policy fixed before an independently drawn challenge and blind to every pre-read cue except the named data ports has no one-port exact match to AND or OR.
